sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This Foundation agent was present at Huntik Foundation Italian HQ when Klaus was released from King Basilisk's Stonegaze power. Later, he and Unnamed Foundation Agent 001 arrested Klaus and took him into Foundation custody. [The Blood Spiral]

This agent was sent to the Castle of Vlad Dracul with Agent 001 to try and subdue the wild Antedeluvian, but to no avail. Later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the Blood Spiral and the agent was rendered unconscious. [Lok's Leadership]

This agent and some other field operatives arrested Rassimov outside the Tomb of Tutankhamun and drove him away to be taken into custody. However, their land rovers were attacked by Harrison Fears and Jericho, freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

This agent later travelled to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and was seen fighting against the Silent Soldiers in the final battle. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, he and several other Foundation members were stationed at the Spiral Mark as they tried to make sense of the data. [Dante's Return]

sections.wikitext: Like most Foundation field operatives, this agent is trained in physical combat and can rely on the standard Huntik Foundation powers.

== History ==
This Foundation agent was present at Huntik Foundation Italian HQ when Klaus was released from King Basilisk's Stonegaze power. Later, he and Unnamed Foundation Agent 001 arrested Klaus and took him into Foundation custody. [The Blood Spiral]

This agent was sent to the Castle of Vlad Dracul with Agent 001 to try and subdue the wild Antedeluvian, but to no avail. Later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the Blood Spiral and the agent was rendered unconscious. [Lok's Leadership]

This agent and some other field operatives arrested Rassimov outside the Tomb of Tutankhamun and drove him away to be taken into custody. However, their land rovers were attacked by Harrison Fears and Jericho, freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

This agent later travelled to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and was seen fighting against the Silent Soldiers in the final battle. '''Unnamed Foundation Agent 002''' is a [[Seeker]] working for the [[Huntik Foundation]]. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, [[Unnamed Foundation Agent 001|001]] and [[Unnamed Foundation Agent 003|003]]. 

== History ==
This Foundation agent was present at [[Huntik Foundation Italian HQ]] when [[Klaus]] was released from [[King Basilisk]]'s Stonegaze power. Later, he and [[Unnamed Foundation Agent 001]] arrested Klaus and took him into Foundation custody. {{source|The Blood Spiral}}

This agent was sent to the [[Castle of Vlad Dracul]] with Agent 001 to try and subdue the wild [[Antedeluvian]], but to no avail. Later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the [[Blood Spiral]] and the agent was rendered unconscious. {{source|Lok's Leadership}}

This agent and some other field operatives arrested [[Rassimov]] outside the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]] and drove him away to be taken into custody. However, their land rovers were attacked by [[Harrison Fears]] and [[Jericho]], freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. {{Source|Rassimov's Secret}}

This agent later travelled to the [[Spiral Mark]] with the rest of the [[Huntik Foundation]] and was seen fighting against the [[Silent Soldiers]] in the final battle. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}} Following the defeat of [[the Betrayer]], he  and several other Foundation members were stationed at the Spiral Mark as they tried to make sense of the data. {{source|Dante's Return}}
